name: @botiverse/raft-desktop-electron
description: Raft Desktop — the native macOS app for Raft, bundling its own frontend and connecting directly to the Raft backend.
author: Botiverse

scripts.build:main: rm -f dist/main.js dist/app-preload.cjs dist/*.map && tsup --config tsup.config.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test src/main/lifecycle.test.ts src/app/oauthLoopback.test.ts src/app/oauthCoordinator.test.ts src/app/enableInput.test.ts frontend/src/desktop/computer/thisComputerLogic.ablation.test.ts frontend/src/desktop/computer/DesktopOnboardingComputerMount.test.ts frontend/src/desktop/notificationDecision.test.ts
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:release: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.release.yml --publish never
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:runtime && pnpm run test:updater
scripts.test:runtime: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --experimental-strip-types --test src/main/appProtocol.test.ts src/main/statusMonitor.test.ts src/main/desktopAssets.test.ts src/main/statusMonitorLifecycle.test.ts src/main/upgradeInfo.test.ts
